question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute a linear slot diffuser in lieu of the specified perforated face diffuser under Section 23 30 00 due to lead time concerns.
proposed_solution: Substitute linear slot alternate diffuser for the specified perforated face diffuser.
routing_rationale: The request involves a substitution of HVAC diffuser equipment specified in Section 23 30 00, requiring review by the Mechanical Engineer.
